feeds.title: Pillar Box Blue
feeds.description: Pillar box blue is all about craft and upcycling. Follow me as I craft and revamp the things around me. The site is full of tutorials to help and inspire you to create. My name is Claire and many of my projects on Pillar Box Blue have some sort of personal connection to me, whether it is in the materials used or inspiration from friends and family.

feeds.title: A Crafty Mix Blog
feeds.description: Multi-award winning DIY and Crafts blog focused on sharing unique recycling and upcycling ideas and tutorials that help you explore your creativity and live a simple beautiful life. A Crafty Mix is all about getting those creative juices flowing and making something new and unusual with things you have at home.

feeds.title: This Crafty Family » Recycled Crafts
feeds.description: Fun recycled craft ideas to try with the whole family! Hi, I'm Kay! I'm mum to two gorgeous and cheeky little monkeys. In this house we love crafts, messy play and fun educational activities. So I started this blog to share some of our favorite ideas so that you can try them with your children too!

feeds.title: My Recycled Bags
feeds.description: Come learn and share information about recycling, crocheting & recycled crafting. Hello, I'm Cindy or aka RecycleCindy. I love to learn and share information about crocheted and other items crafted from recycled materials. This is a green, eco-friendly website that is dedicated to recycling and crafting.

feeds.title: Sadie Seasongoods
feeds.description: Welcome to Sadie Seasongoods- my blog dedicated to approachable repurposing and upcycling projects using vintage treasures and thrifted finds!

feeds.title: Crafts by Amanda » Recycled Crafts
feeds.description: Craft tutorials include kid's crafts, adult crafts, painting, recycled crafts, green crafts, wedding crafts, and plenty of DIY projects as well. Amanda is known for making something out of nothing using all sorts of reclaimed and recycled items, most times from things you can find around your home.

feeds.title: Crafty Messy Mom » Recycled Crafts
feeds.description: Find the latest posts about recycled crafts written by me, Marzia Fa. I'm a creative maker, visual artist but above all a mum. I especially love painting, cooking and doing all kinds of handcrafting for and with children.

feeds.title: Mod Podge Rocks Blog » Recycled Crafts
feeds.description: Learn how to make some cool recycled crafts with Mod Podge! There are a ton of ideas here that I think you'll enjoy, for both kids and adults! I'm Amy Anderson, a lifelong crafter with a blog, two books, and a product line. I was born from creative genes, so I'm carrying on the tradition. I have been knitting for 20+ years, sewing for longer and decoupaging for almost 10.

feeds.title: WhimziVille
feeds.description: WhimziVille gives you new whimsical craft and repurposing ideas almost everyday. Hi! I'm Patty Thurlby, a full time artist with a whimsical point of view and I love to go on creative adventures.

feeds.title: Recycled Crafts
feeds.description: Recycled Crafts brings you creative upcycle and downcycle ideas. CraftGossip recycling is all about the variety of projects people come up with to live an eco-friendly yet pretty and festive lifestyle. Find great craft and DIY ideas all year round.

feeds.title: Unique Creations By Anita
feeds.description: DIY projects for home decoration made from recycled, repurposed and restored furniture. Get step by step tutorials to help you recreate each project. My Name is Anita Holland, I am a self taught DIY and Craft fanatic, building all my projects from mainly recycled materials. My goal is trying to come up with projects you don't see everyday.
